about: Note extraction (extraction.extract_info) with a fixed reference date. Checks: the right initiative, the right to-dos with correct owner and resolved deadline, short bullet points that don't repeat the to-dos, no deadline words left in task text, and names capitalised.

cases.text: Partner feedback on the IC memo: valuation is fine but the risks section is too thin. I need to add a downside case with the top client churning by Friday, and Priya will send the fuel cost report tomorrow.
Fixed income: convexity corrects duration for large rate moves. Longer maturity and lower coupon mean higher duration. Make flashcards on this by next Monday.
Credit spread is corporate yield minus G-sec yield. AAA spreads in India are around 60-80 bps and widen when credit risk rises.
gym with anita: deadlifts down to 3x5, add mobility twice a week. buy a foam roller this weekend
Call with rohan from acme logistics. He liked the demo but thinks pricing is high. He'll get back to us after talking to his team next Monday. I have to send a pricing comparison by Friday 5pm.
Idea: a weekly digest every Sunday of people I owe replies to, reusing the morning brief pipeline
Decided with the partners to keep the base valuation at 1,350 Cr and run sensitivities on WACC 12-14%. Concern: customer concentration, top 5 clients are 46% of revenue.
